description: Solana DeFi risk checks for AI agents: token launches, holders after merging linked wallets, wallets, pools, CLMM ranges, perp venues and a swap preflight. Each check answers with a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, unknown), the reasons and the evidence. Three tools are free; paid tools take an API key or a per-call USDC payment over x402.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http dexra https://api.dexra.dev/mcp

notes: Optional. Send `Authorization: Bearer <DEXRA_API_KEY>` (or `X-Api-Key`) to the hosted endpoint; keys come from https://dexra.dev/app/keys.
Without a key the free tools work (describe_address, service_stats, score_performance) and paid tools are paid per call in USDC over x402.
`npx -y @dexra-dev/mcp` is a stdio bridge to the hosted endpoint for clients that only run local servers; it reads DEXRA_API_KEY.

clients: Any MCP client supporting Streamable HTTP
license: Hosted service. Client packages and configs are MIT: https://github.com/dexra-dev/mcp

notes: Profile claimed by @oblivisheee, owner of the dexra-dev GitHub organization and the @dexra-dev npm scope, in #4129.
The hosted endpoint answers tools/list without a key with the 12 tools listed here.
